title: Bound to the Enemy
logline: When a hunter and her vampire enemy receive matching marks from an ancient threat, she must choose between finishing her hunt and trusting him to keep them both alive.
target_audience: US fantasy-romance viewers who enjoy enemies-to-allies tension, supernatural suspense, and fast serialized drama.
hook: Mara corners vampire Lucien at blade-point—then the same burning black mark appears on both their wrists.
synopsis: Hunter Mara Voss corners vampire Lucien Vale in a rain-soaked gothic district, but matching ancient marks interrupt her strike. After choosing to spare him, Mara discovers that distance makes the marks spread while contact stabilizes them. She arms her enemy and declares a ceasefire—just as the force that marked them seals their escape.
episode_goal: Force Mara to choose cooperation over vengeance when an ancient mark binds her survival to Lucien's.

characters.motivation: Protect others from supernatural threats without becoming controlled by one.

characters.description: A guarded vampire with sharp instincts, dangerous charm, and knowledge of old supernatural forces.
characters.motivation: Survive the ancient threat while keeping his freedom from hunters.
